lanes.linear_title: Keep secrets and stack traces out of customer-visible errors
lanes.linear_description:
## Context
Verified on #564 (084b48c5):
- src/components/debug/AppErrorBoundary.tsx:85 renders `this.state.error.message` verbatim to customers.
- src/lib/error-message.ts `getUserFacingErrorMessage` returns raw Error and record messages. For records without a message it returns the JSON of the compacted record, which error-message.test.ts pins in 'serializes PostgREST-style objects when needed'.
- So strings the server provides, such as JWT-shaped tokens, emails or stack frames, can reach toasts and dialogs.
- #564's quote-confirmation lane renders the real ClientPart page with every request intercepted. Its config sets testMatch `*.browser.ts`, and CI runs it in the step 'Test Free quote confirmation and replay in browser'.

## Scope
Tests come first:
- `e2e/quote-confirmation/errors.browser.ts` makes RPC failures (a scope-lookup 400, a dispatch 500, a quote-access error) whose bodies carry five sentinels: a JWT-shaped string (three base64url segments starting with eyJ), 'service_role', 'storageState', a stack frame such as 'at fn (https://x.invalid/a.js:1:2)', and an email address. It asserts that no sentinel appears in any toast, dialog or body text, and that a finite message plus a next action (retry or close) is shown.
- Unit cases in src/lib/error-message.test.ts.
- A new src/components/debug/AppErrorBoundary.test.tsx.
- A unit case for the upload toast in src/features/quotes/use-client-job-file-picker.ts.

The minimal fix:
- a tested deny-pattern list applied to the final string in getUserFacingErrorMessage, where a match returns the fallback, default 'Something went wrong.';
- AppErrorBoundary renders the raw message only when import.meta.env.DEV, and otherwise 'Something went wrong.'. The heading, the Reference id and Reload stay.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Failure first, recorded: errors.browser.ts shows at least one sentinel before the fix. If nothing leaks in this lane, the new unit tests show the leak through getUserFacingErrorMessage or AppErrorBoundary.
- [ ] After the fix, `npm run e2e:quote-confirmation` passes, existing and new cases alike, and vitest passes for error-message, AppErrorBoundary and use-client-job-file-picker.
- [ ] Positive control: existing customer-facing server messages without sentinels still display unchanged, for example 'Founding Beta access and current notice acceptance are required.'.
- [ ] The pinned test 'serializes PostgREST-style objects when needed' is unchanged unless its payload matches a deny pattern. Replacing PostgREST JSON wholesale is an open owner question.
- [ ] No new copy: only the existing default 'Something went wrong.'.
- [ ] scripts/quote-confirmation-browser-contract.test.mjs passes. quote.browser.ts and testMatch are untouched.

## Verification commands
```bash
flock /tmp/ovd-e2e.lock sudo -u ubuntu -H env PATH=$PATH PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers npm run e2e:quote-confirmation
npx vitest run src/lib/error-message.test.ts src/components/debug/AppErrorBoundary.test.tsx src/features/quotes/use-client-job-file-picker.test.tsx scripts/quote-confirmation-browser-contract.test.mjs
npm run lint && npm run typecheck
flock /tmp/ovd-verify.lock npm run verify
```

## Out of scope
- Restyling AppErrorBoundary (Lane B).
- The ?debug=1 diagnostics policy (Q25).
- Replacing every PostgREST JSON payload (open question).
- Any wording change.

Parent: OVD-319
lanes.guidance:
OWNER-DECISION RE-SCOPE (2026-10-04): A previous attempt stopped because existing enrollment/upload messages intentionally include the support email (src/features/quotes/founding-beta-access.ts:76,78,84; test founding-beta-access.test.ts:32) and are shown via toast.error, so an EMAIL deny-pattern would break approved copy. Therefore: DO NOT add an email deny pattern, and DO NOT change how PostgREST code/details/hint payloads are summarized (that is also an open owner question). Scope ONLY the uncontroversial boundary: customer-visible error text (AppErrorBoundary rendering of error.message, getUserFacingErrorMessage, toasts) must never show JWT-shaped tokens (eyJ...\.eyJ...), the literal 'service_role' / service-role keys, storageState/session/cookie dumps, or stack-trace frames (e.g. 'at Foo (/path/file.ts:12:3)'). Replace such content with the existing generic fallback string already used in the code (no new copy). Keep the support-email messages byte-identical. Original guidance for structure/tests follows:

COMMON RULES (all units):
(1) Create the worktree under /home/user/wt/errsan: `git -C /home/user/Overdrafter fetch origin && git -C /home/user/Overdrafter worktree add /home/user/wt/errsan -b <branch> origin/codex/recovered-release-free-safety-20261003`. Never edit /home/user/Overdrafter.
(2) Run `npm ci`.
(3) Take locks in this order: /tmp/ovd-supabase.lock, then /tmp/ovd-e2e.lock, then /tmp/ovd-verify.lock. Run `flock /tmp/ovd-replay.lock true` before Playwright.
(4) Run Playwright as ubuntu with the sandbox on: `chmod -R a+rwX /home/user/wt/errsan`, then `sudo -u ubuntu -H env PATH=$PATH PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers ...`.
(5) Commit trailers per ENV.md. No force-push.
(6) The PR title starts with this unit's issue ID. Never write the parent ID anywhere.
(7) No new customer copy. If 'Something went wrong.' is not adequate somewhere, stop and report.
(8) Code must be strict-null clean in touched files. Use sonner only.
(9) Do not edit .sonarcloud.properties.

STEPS
1. Read e2e/quote-confirmation/network.ts and data.ts. The backend already has accessMode 'error', scopeMode 'error' and denialCode.
   - Add the sentinel bodies from the new spec through the backend's public knobs where possible.
   - If network.ts or data.ts must change, keep the change minimal and update scripts/quote-confirmation-browser-contract.test.mjs to match.
   - Never touch quote.browser.ts or playwright.config.ts.
2. Write errors.browser.ts. For each failure, collect `document.body.innerText` plus every [data-sonner-toast] and role=dialog text, and assert that none of the five sentinels appears. Also assert that a visible message and an enabled retry or close control exist.
3. Run it before any fix and record which sentinels leak.
4. Unit tests:
   - error-message deny-list cases: one per pattern, a mixed case, and a clean server message unchanged (positive control);
   - AppErrorBoundary.test.tsx: render a child that throws Error('eyJ...service_role'). In production mode (vi.stubEnv / import.meta.env.DEV false) the raw message is absent and 'Something went wrong.' shows. In DEV the raw message shows. The heading, Reference and Reload are present in both.
   - a use-client-job-file-picker case where an upload error carrying a sentinel toasts the fallback.
5. Implement the fix:
   - In getUserFacingErrorMessage, compute the candidate string as today, then `if (DENY_PATTERNS.some(p => p.test(candidate))) return fallback`. Export DENY_PATTERNS so it can be tested directly.
   - Patterns: JWT /eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{5,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{5,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{5,}/, /service_role/i, /storageState/, /\bat \S+ \(?\S+:\d+:\d+\)?/, /[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/.
   - Do NOT add a raw-JSON pattern; that is an open owner question.
   - In AppErrorBoundary, gate the raw message on import.meta.env.DEV. captureDiagnosticError keeps receiving the raw error.
6. Search for existing tests that expect an email or other deny-pattern text in an error message: `git grep -n '@' -- 'src/**/*.test.ts*' | grep -i error`. If any exist, keep them, stop and report.

Schedule: lane B, order 5.
lanes.failure_first:
Write the unit tests and the quote-confirmation browser case first with synthetic sentinels (JWT-shaped string, 'service_role', storageState JSON, a stack frame) in PostgREST message fields and thrown errors; show they surface in the UI on the base (084b48c5), then fix. Also assert the support email still appears in the not_enrolled upload message (regression guard). 1. Write errors.browser.ts and the unit tests before changing error-message.ts or AppErrorBoundary.tsx.
2. Run `npm run e2e:quote-confirmation` as ubuntu under the e2e lock. Record which sentinel appears and where.
3. The AppErrorBoundary test must fail: the raw message renders in production mode. The deny-list unit tests must fail too.
4. Record all outputs, then implement and rerun until everything is green.
